Officer's narrative
Driver 1 was traveling in the eastbound lane when the vehicle collided head-on with Driver 2's vehicle at low speed.
Officers arrived to find both vehicles stopped in the roadway with front-end damage cnosistent with the impact
described by both drivers. Driver 2 stated that the collision occurred as Driver 1 reported, and two independent
witnesses gave matching accounts of the sequence. Scene photographs taken by officers show damage patterns that
align with the reported force of the impact. Driver 1 and a Passenger were both seated in the vehicle at the time, and
officers and witnesses confirmed their presence. No prior damage to either vehicle was observed or reported. Driver
1 is listed as the named insured on the policy covering the vehicle. Driver 1 complained of neck and back discomfort
at the scene and was transported for evaluation. The injuries described are consistent with the mechanics of a
collision of this type and severity.
